name: In'yoku no Tsuugaku Densha ~Iya na no ni Saretai Watashi wa Ochiteiku~
original_name: 淫欲の通学電車 ～嫌なのにされたい私は堕ちていく～
source:
A crowded train one morning.

My hand is on her butt.
I have to let go of him right away, but I can’t resist the soft touch I feel from time to time.
I don’t think this should happen, but for some reason her arm won’t move…

This is the end for me too.
I can’t believe my life is going to end in a place like this…
If this girl lets out one scream, she really is…

But she didn’t resist or scream.
On the contrary, she allows herself to be done to her…and just like that, she reaches her first climax.

“Ah, ah…”

Why did I do such a terrible thing?
I don’t know what to do, but I have to apologize…
Those thoughts keep spinning around in my head.

“Eh~ Next time~”

She thought she did it.
She arrives at the station and the door opens.
I felt her excitement and guilt as I ran away from her…
translation:
一天早上，一列拥挤的火车。

我的手放在她的屁股上。
我必须立刻放开他，但我无法抗拒时不时感受到的柔软触感。
我认为这不应该发生，但出于某种原因她的手臂无法动……

这对我来说也是结局。
我不敢相信我的生命会在这样的地方结束……
如果这个女孩发出一声尖叫，她真的是……

但她没有反抗，也没有尖叫。
相反，她允许自己被别人对待……就这样，她达到了第一个高潮。

“啊啊啊……”

我为什么要做这么可怕的事？
我不知道该怎么办，但我必须道歉……
这些想法一直在我的脑海里盘旋。

“呃~下次吧~”

她以为她做到了。
她到达车站，门打开了。
当我逃离她时，我感受到了她的兴奋和愧疚……
